Subject: Azure co-sell takeoff: account tiling & seller batch plan

Hi Maria,

Thanks for taking the time earlier. To get the Azure co-sell motion running smoothly between CloudScale and Redwood, I'm proposing a short "takeoff" cadence this month to map accounts, assign seller batches, and ensure Partner Center referrals are enabled for the right subscriptions.

Quick asks to move this forward:
- Can you share a CSV export of your top 250 target accounts (attached is a sample column layout we prefer)? Please include Azure Tenant ID / Subscription ID where possible.
- Confirm who on your side owns Partner Center referral consent and whether referral consent is toggled on for the accounts in question.
- Availability for a 45-minute kickoff next week (proposed: Wed 7/12 10:00–10:45 PT).

I've attached a blank takeoff_worksheet.xlsx and a short handshake draft (draft-handshake.md) that outlines the consent & lead routing steps we recommend. Our plan is to tile accounts into three seller batches (High-touch, Mid-touch, Light-touch) and route Partner Center referrals to the seller assigned for the batch.

If it's helpful, we'll also run a small pilot (25 accounts) to validate referral linkage and attribution before a wider roll.

Thanks — look forward to syncing.

—Rachel Kim

Redwood Inference

Folks — forwarding Maria's roster. Key asks: we need a proposal for the seller batch assignments and a mapping heuristic that we can share in the kickoff. High-level proposal below:

Proposed mapping heuristic (first pass):
- High-touch (top 50): ARR > $250k OR Strategic exec relationship flagged in roster. Manual seller assignment; concierge outreach.
- Mid-touch (next 100): ARR $50k–250k OR accounts showing Azure Marketplace consumption > $10k/month. Seller outreach + templated playbooks.
- Light-touch (remaining): automated email + entry into nurture cadence; referral attribution captured via PC referral id.

Routing rules:
- Partner Center referrals should land with the assigned seller for that account; if consent is not present, route to Marketplace Ops (procure@cloudscale.com) + Redwood Solutions for ingestion.
- For accounts with missing Tenant ID, run a 3-step match: domain -> public AZ tenant registry -> manual confirmation with CS.

Action items before kickoff (owner -> due):
- Ben: validate we can bulk-assign PC referral targets via our intake API and confirm quota impact (due EOD Thu 7/12).
- Vanessa: prepare seller roster and suggested batch boundaries (due morning 7/12).
- Karthik: draft the referral fallback policy & doc link for the kickoff (due 7/12 2pm).
- Rachel: I will consolidate and run the pilot selection (20 accounts) and share the pilot playbook.

Also flagged two potential friction points for discussion in the kickoff:
1) Referral consent gaps in Partner Center for accounts that have consumed via marketplace but haven't enabled referral consent.
2) Attribution overlap where multiple seller owners claim the same account (we'll propose a temporary escrow with SupplierOps if needed).

--Rachel
